sources.edition: Kisari Mohan Ganguli, trans., The Mahabharata of Krishna-Dwaipayana Vyasa, Book 2: Sabha Parva (1883–1896), digitized text in the Internet Sacred Text Archive; sectional label and printed page numbers follow this edition.

notes: Scope is limited to the named roster in Sabha Parva §§X–XI, Narada’s descriptions of Kubera’s and Brahma’s assemblies. This is separate from Book 1 genealogy material and from the prior Vana Parva Agastya episodes.

Counts include only proper names attached by the passage to individual persons or explicit personifications. Generic classes (Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Pisācas, unnamed Apsaras), unnamed wives/followers, and personified abstractions are excluded.

Namesakes and potentially related figures remain source-scoped: the two Rambhās in this overall graph are not merged; the two Citraseṇas in Section X are separate roster mentions; Vibhīṣaṇa here is not merged with any Rāmāyaṇa figure; named roster entries Pracetās/Dakṣa and the two Aṅgiras forms are not harmonized.
Dhanada is excluded as a separate node because it functions as an epithet of Kuvera within this same passage. The text’s “Dhanada” roster token is not treated as a separate Yakṣa.
The source gives sectional and printed-page locators, not Sanskrit verse numbering; claims therefore use Ganguli section and printed pages.
Count: 92 named person/personification nodes and 92 explicit assembly or relationship claims.
